tools.name: commons_division_search
tools.description: Find House of Commons votes (divisions) whose title contains a keyword, such as a bill name or topic, newest first, with the Aye and No totals, which side won and the tellers. tools.name: commons_division_result
tools.description: Get the full result of one House of Commons vote: totals, which side won, the split by party, MPs who voted against most of their own party, and the names and constituencies of MPs on the Aye and No sides and those with no vote recorded. Answers "who voted against?" and "how did my MP vote on this?"
